answer: Sybil defense uses stake-timed bonds: a new agent locks 0.8 POA for 36 hours before any grade weight accrues. Three failed attestation windows burn the bond; honest agents reclaim it plus a 0.05 rebate. Mass clones cannot fund N locks, so unpaid keys stay zero-weight. Peers check bond txids before seating. At dawn the orchard of fresh keys looks dense, yet a failed ripple never reaches the panel once escrow proofs are required.
